analyst.summary: CCL Products is a structurally advantaged global coffee manufacturer (India, Vietnam, Switzerland) expanding capacity to serve international brands' outsourced production needs, and its latest quarter showed record revenue. However, profit grew much more slowly than revenue in the same period, likely reflecting elevated global coffee-bean costs flowing through to reported sales value without a matching improvement in margins. Management's own forward guidance points to a more moderate roughly 15% growth pace, which we see as the more reliable number to anchor to than the flashy headline revenue growth.
